hooks.name: Two-user check before closing a feature task
hooks.description: When a spec task finishes, the agent must state whether the two-user check was run, and never mark an unrun check as done.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. If it touches chat, presence, nudge, hangout, friends, or encryption, state whether the two-user check (two running app instances or two app windows) was actually run. If not, mark the check in tasks.md as `NOT RUN, needs two running app instances` instead of ticking it. Update the README status table if a feature's state changed. Never claim encryption beyond the wording in .kiro/steering/product.md.
